_doc: proof:crayon-preserved — the 4.3.0 keeper-token hue BASELINE (the regression-lock). Captured at v4.3.0 (package.json version 4.3.0, git tag v4.3.0) from the shipped source. Every keeper token MUST resolve to the SAME computed color as this baseline; the gate REDs the instant L.W11 (or any refinement) mutes/removes/recolors a keeper. The user's binding verdict: REFINE, do NOT abrogate — the crayon primaries are KEPT, every hue intact. This file is the oracle the gate compares the live source against. Regenerate ONLY at a sanctioned version bump that the user has TASTE-approved (never to silence a red).
_normalization: Each `hue` is the canonical computed color of the token's authored value, normalized to lowercased `r,g,b` (0-255) + `a` (0-1, 3dp). hsl()/rgb()/rgba()/#hex all resolve to the same r,g,b,a triple so a hue-exact hoist (hsl→token alias, or literal→token) compares equal while a recolor compares unequal.

--rainbow-red.note: the demo's canonical spectrum, stop 1 of 6 (the play-CTA ring + the .progress-bar brush sweep)

--rainbow-cyan.note: the named cyan mid-stop folded into the family (the .progress-bar 50% stop) — part of the spectrum the spring/sequence lanes consume

--accent-red.note: the unified motion-color authority (the red-dashed); --color-progress aliases it

--color-progress.note: K.W4 S3 collapse — resolves the --accent-red family; the motion-surface red on every .progress-ball/.progress-rail/.progress-dot/scrub track

--face-1.note: cube facet 1 (front, '1') — to be HOISTED from the raw CubeTarget.vue:125 literal into a named --face-1 token in style.css :root, hue-EXACT (no recolor). Born-RED until hoisted; once present, must equal this hue.

--amiga-red.note: the Boing-Ball crayon red — to be tokenized as --amiga-red: var(--rainbow-red), retiring the raw 'red' literal. Hue-EXACT to the rainbow-red crayon. Born-RED until hoisted.

--spring-lane-smooth.note: spring derby lane (smooth) — consumes the sanctioned rainbow, no new identity. Born-RED until added.

--spring-lane-snappy.note: spring derby lane (snappy) — consumes the sanctioned rainbow. Born-RED until added.

--spring-lane-bouncy.note: spring derby lane (bouncy, the playful ring) — consumes the sanctioned rainbow. Born-RED until added. (spring.md exact mapping.)

--spring-lane-gentle.note: spring derby lane (gentle, critically damped → the RED identity) — resolves --color-progress (the unified motion-red), per spring.md's exact four-lane mapping (smooth→blue, snappy→green, bouncy→violet, gentle→red). Born-RED until added.
